terminal_regression.execution_note: Build prerequisites sequential; two independent test processes with isolated fixture directories/ephemeral peer ports. No BBS probes run concurrently.

call_frame_validation.scope: Serialized DOS MZ and linker-map validation of twenty-four explicit near-cdecl entries, eight compiler register callbacks, twenty-one resident word-cdecl callbacks and seven explicit zero-argument callbacks; exact argument-copy frames, target calls/returns, relocations and full configuration C extent. Independent CPU candidate/directory/owner suites and actual DOS child allocation exercise behavior.

terminal_candidate.scope: Actual source-built DOS8086 pure candidate decoder and shared directory transaction. All interrupts/IN/OUT forbidden during CPU replay; separate diagnostic DOS C-runtime/file-owner equivalence test uses synthetic PRM/DIR only. Candidate/active/source atomicity and classification, not live application commit, UART/profile handoff or setup invocation.

Parent resumes actual far controller polling after child return. NormalUART/vector cleanup verified by existing sampler. No physical modem claim.
